content.value_statement: Revenue-based bidding can favor sales that produce weak margins. This skill builds and checks conversion values that reflect contribution profit.
actual_capabilities: Inventories revenue and non-revenue conversion actions.
Maps revenue and COGS data into net conversion values.
Derives proxy values from close rates and average net order value.
Recommends static or dynamic value rules with stated reasoning.
Reconciles platform conversion value against booked business profit.
Produces a value model specification and pre-launch QA sheet.
limitations: It does not verify whether tracking tags fire correctly.
It does not resolve cross-platform attribution or duplicate orders.
It cannot derive reliable profit values without margin, COGS, or close-rate inputs.
It does not change advertising platform settings or score the complete account.

use_cases.title: Prepare ecommerce tROAS bidding
use_cases.description: Convert product revenue and category margins into dynamic net values before launching tROAS.

use_cases.title: Value lead generation actions
use_cases.description: Estimate defensible values for leads and calls using close rates and average net order value.

use_cases.title: Audit an existing value model
use_cases.description: Compare platform conversion values with booked contribution profit and identify launch blockers.

prompt_templates.title: Map basic purchase values
prompt_templates.prompt: Map my purchase conversion values for tROAS. I have revenue and a blended margin of [percentage].
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup with one margin rate

prompt_templates.title: Build category margin values
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a conversion value model from my GA4 revenue export and category COGS export. Explain every net-value calculation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Ecommerce setup with varying category margins

prompt_templates.title: Derive non-revenue proxy values
prompt_templates.prompt: Value leads, calls, and signups using my close rates and average net order value. Mark missing inputs and assumptions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Lead generation with downstream sales data

prompt_templates.title: Run an advanced value audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit my current value rules against booked contribution profit. Check double adjustments, static versus dynamic logic, reconciliation gaps, and launch readiness.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review before scaling value-based bidding

output_examples.input: Purchase revenue is $200 and category margin is 35%.
output_examples.output: Purchase net value: $70. Basis: measured revenue multiplied by the user-provided category margin.

output_examples.input: Average net order value is $120 and lead-to-sale close rate is 10%.
output_examples.output: Estimated lead proxy value: $12. The value requires review when the close rate changes.

output_examples.input: Platform value totals $30,000 while booked contribution profit is $10,000.
output_examples.output: Not launch-ready. Platform value is three times booked contribution profit, so the value mapping needs correction.

best_practices: Provide recent revenue, COGS, and margin data at the most useful product level.
Label each input as measured, user-provided, or estimated.
Reconcile total platform value with booked contribution profit before launch.
anti_patterns: Do not invent margin rates or proxy values when required inputs are missing.
Do not apply a value rule to values that already include the same adjustment.
Do not treat value reconciliation as a substitute for tracking or attribution QA.

faq.question: Does this skill verify conversion tracking?
faq.answer: No. It defines conversion values after the underlying events have been verified.

faq.question: Can it work with a blended margin?
faq.answer: Yes. It labels the result as estimated and records the blended rate.

faq.question: How are lead values calculated?
faq.answer: It multiplies average net order value by the lead-to-sale close rate.

faq.question: Does it support static and dynamic values?
faq.answer: Yes. It recommends the simplest defensible method based on value variation and available data.

faq.question: Can it update Google Ads or Meta directly?
faq.answer: No. It produces a specification and QA result for implementation.

faq.question: What happens when required data is missing?
faq.answer: The affected value is marked as needing input instead of receiving a guessed value.
